Name: Prismatic Pig for Prismatic Shards
Author: Dionaeam
Description:
A very dear friend of mine suggested it would be cool to have a type of farm animal that "gave" Prismatic Shards. So, I made this Pig, with the help of the amazing mod [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25287]Prismatic Valley Framework[/url], by[url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/212901518] JollyAxolotl[/url].

Info about the mod:  There's a chance of 25% to buy Prismatic Pig while buying the regular pig at Marnie's (similar to the blue chicken).
                                    You need at least 4 hearts with Vincent for the Prismatic Pig to be available at Marnie's.
                                    The PrismaticPig finds Truffles an Prismatic Shards, depending on both friendship level and daily luck.

PT-BR translation included.


Also with the help of [url=http://https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/alichanST/about-me?gameId=1303]alichanST﻿[/url], my modding teacher.

Downloads.Description: Prismatic Pig added to Marnie's Shop. PT-BR translation.
